description.value: Sushi 7 is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver offering a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, donburi, and noodle dishes. It has built a loyal local following with 151 reviews and is known for consistent quality and fast service. An online ordering system with a quick pickup turnaround makes it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Cambie corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: hoop at 8m; hoop (4 spaces) at 28m; stands (2 spaces) at 32m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; hoop at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; heart (2 spaces) at 75m; rack at 84m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the OSM address (3488 Cambie St, Vancouver, BC V5Z2W8) and phone (+1 604-709-8150). The site prominently features online ordering with a 15-minute pickup option, and the menu legend explicitly marks vegetarian items with multiple plant-based dishes listed. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sushi 7 Japanese Bar & Grill' but the website consistently uses 'Sushi 7 - Vancouver'; the 'Bar & Grill' designation may be outdated or informal.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant on a well-used cycling corridor and a reasonable food stop for touring cyclists, but none of the key WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike parking or visibility before including.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu legend includes a vegetarian icon; multiple vegetarian dishes listed including Tofu Don, Vegetable Tempura, Mixed Veggie Gyoza, Veggie Spring Roll, and Veggie Sunomono
